channel.description: Автоматическая лента: хайтек, умное садоводство, наука, технологии

item.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
item.description: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

item.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
item.description: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

item.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan uses AI agents so much, he spends up to $200K a year on tokens
item.description: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

item.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
item.description: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.

item.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
item.description: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.

item.title: Trajectory raises $45M to make AI model training accessible to nontechnical experts
item.description: The one-year-old startup is now valued at $300 million.

item.title: CVE-2026-98432: временный nftables-фильтр с автооткатом
item.description: Временная мера против CVE-2026-98432 уже развернута на 26 серверах. Ниже - порядок применения nftables-фильтра: от проверки пакета ядра до отката и загрузки правила после перезапуска. Команды рассчитаны на Ubuntu с nftables и systemd, для входящего трафика самого хоста. Для трафика, пересылаемого контейнерам или другим узлам, нужно отдельно выбрать цепочку фильтрации. item.title: Apple’s inventory surges 154% as memory chip costs climb
item.description: Apple says unprecedented memory chip costs will continue to rise, raising questions about future device prices as its inventory climbs to $14.5 billion.

item.description: Apple CEO John Ternus doesn't have a timeline for when iPhone Duo supply constraints could lift. item.title: Хакертьюб хакертьюба: 30 лучших интервью из проекта Андрея Карпатого, которые можно прочитать за минуту
item.description: Я прочитал на Хабре , как Андрей Карпатый в пятницу вечером разозлился на рекомендации YouTube, а в субботу утром за два часа сделал HackerTube : витрину из 6454 видео, которые участники Hacker News годами советуют друг другу.
